title: Application & Supply-Chain Security: Binary Authorization & SLSA — D4
purpose: Shows identities, trust boundaries, policy checks, and audit evidence.
routing_rationale: Software supply chain security mandates cryptographic verification at every step: no container image may execute in production unless it was built by an approved CI pipeline and certified free of critical CVEs.

nodes.label: Cloud Build (Isolated Worker)
nodes.detail: Builds container in isolated environment without unvetted internet dependencies.

nodes.label: KMS Attestation Signer
nodes.detail: Digitally signs in-toto build provenance attestation with enterprise private key.

nodes.label: Artifact Analysis Vulnerability Scan
nodes.detail: Scans image layers for OS and language package vulnerabilities against CVE databases.

nodes.label: Binary Authorization Attestor
nodes.detail: Verifies zero Critical/High CVEs exist before writing verified security attestation.

nodes.label: Binary Authorization Gatekeeper
nodes.detail: Intercepts pod creation requests; verifies cryptographically signed attestations before pod starts.

steps.title: Hermetic Build & Signing
steps.action: Cloud Build compiles container in private worker pool and signs provenance with KMS.
steps.why_traversal: Guarantees container artifact originates from exact immutable Git commit.

steps.title: Vulnerability Audit & Attestation
steps.action: Artifact Analysis scans all packages; attestor attaches signed security certificate.
steps.why_traversal: Validates software quality before image is authorized for deployment.

steps.title: GKE Admission Enforcement
steps.action: Binary Authorization admission webhook verifies both attestations and admits pod.
steps.why_traversal: Guarantees unauthorized or modified images cannot execute in production.

scenarios.label: Untrusted Public DockerHub Image Blocked
scenarios.root_cause: Attacker compromised GKE credentials and attempted to deploy unapproved cryptocurrency miner.
scenarios.diverted_path: Binary Authorization blocks deployment: 'Image denied: missing required attestations'.
scenarios.recovery: Rotate compromised Kubernetes service account and audit cluster RBAC bindings.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Shows identities, trust boundaries, policy checks, and audit evidence.
